title: AI Intelligence Explained
description:
Most people calling their systems AI agents are actually missing one critical piece. True autonomy.

What most businesses are running is an incredibly powerful tool that requires you to communicate with it to function. You ask, it executes. That is not an autonomous agent. That is a sophisticated workflow with intelligence built in. Still valuable. Just not what the word agent technically means.

The honest way to think about how these systems work is to imagine a skilled human doing the same job. You ask for a carousel. They check if they know how to make one. If not they figure it out. They gather the tools. They ask you what you want. They research your reference. They build it. They come back and ask what you think. They reason about what went wrong and try again.

That is exactly what the system is doing. The difference is it uses directives, executions, and tools instead of hands and a browser.
Understanding this closes the gap between the hype around AI agents and what you are actually building.
